# arbextract

Source: https://github.com/koaaN/arbextract

Pinned upstream commit: `320efd96ded606b6bbf9c0c9d04ceb35caba32a6`.

`upstream/arbextract.c` and `LICENSE` are verbatim upstream files (MIT).
`windows_utf8.c` is a local Windows command-line/filesystem encoding adapter,
used by both 32-bit and 64-bit builds. It leaves the upstream ARB parser unchanged.
